title: 租赁合同纠纷 — governance source discovery and adaptation design

source_discovery.next_action: Locate and record an authoritative source for a rental-contract civil complaint before any mapping or content change is proposed.

scope_note: Post-baseline addendum only. It does not alter the frozen five-case planning counts (15 routes, 131 gaps, 199 crosswalks) and it does not authorize any runtime change. The existing rental output is a project-authored software baseline, not an official template or legal authority.

claims: request termination when the user selects that status
arrears amount with an optional arrears period
vacate and return the premises when the contract is terminated or termination is requested and the premises are not returned

known_legal_questions: Whether the correct official counterpart is a generic lease dispute, a residential lease dispute, a commercial lease dispute, or a separate variant.
Whether the plaintiff's right to rent or authority to sublease must be captured and reviewed before asserting a rent claim.
Whether the complaint should request termination, confirm an already-completed termination, or remain silent on contract status in each procedural posture.
Whether arrears, late fees, deposit set-off, occupation-use fees and damages must be separated into distinct claims.
Whether demand/notice, termination notice, return of premises and the date of actual return require separate user-confirmed fields.
Which court has jurisdiction when the property location, defendant residence and contractual jurisdiction clause differ.
Whether an official standalone evidence-list or service-address confirmation form exists for rental disputes.

tasks.objective: Locate candidate authoritative sources for rental-contract complaint, evidence-list and service-address documents.
exit_criteria: A source record with an official URL and explicit nulls for unknown attributes is created.
The source is not described as verified or approved merely because a URL exists.

tasks.objective: Verify source identity, version, level, hash and local artifact status.
exit_criteria: The source reaches SOURCE_FILE_VERIFIED with a recorded hash and evidence.
No content or legal conclusion is inferred from the file hash alone.

tasks.objective: Compare official elements and document structure with the current rental fields, claims and facts.
exit_criteria: A written comparison records elements, sections, omissions and conditionality differences.
Any proposed rental field or narrative change is identified with a gap record.

tasks.objective: Decide whether each rental document type has a correct official counterpart.
exit_criteria: Mapping entries are added to case-template-mapping.json only after source evidence exists.
Each entry remains unapproved unless a separate legal review approves it.

tasks.objective: Review rental claims, facts, conditionality and procedural applicability.
exit_criteria: A documented legal/content decision exists with reviewer role and date.
Automated tests are not treated as legal approval.

tasks.objective: Determine whether any official source may be adapted or redistributed.
exit_criteria: A rights decision is recorded separately from source verification and legal content review.
No official text is copied into the application without a cleared rights decision.

tasks.objective: Implement only a scoped, authorized adaptation after all preceding gates pass.
exit_criteria: A scoped engineering authorization exists.
The existing rental runtime remains the project-authored baseline until then.

tasks.objective: Validate accepted changes across all six case types and three document types.
exit_criteria: Automated DOCX structural tests pass.
A human/WPS or Word pagination and table-layout check is recorded.

tasks.objective: Decide whether the authorized change may ship.
exit_criteria: Release approval is recorded separately from engineering acceptance.
No release approval is implied by a Git commit or a passing test suite.
All three rental document types have an explicit source/counterpart decision.
Rental fields and narrative claims have a documented legal/content review.
Any mapping entry is added only with source evidence and remains unapproved until separately approved.
Any runtime change has scoped engineering authorization and passes DOCX regression plus visual inspection.
Release approval is recorded separately.
non_claims: No official rental-contract template has been identified or approved.
No legal review has been performed.
No rights or redistribution decision has been made.
No implementation or release is authorized.
The current rental output is a software baseline only.
